recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It narrowly completes the Published FHIR-22765 resolution; future work should only revisit it if PA wants a different computability rule for partial dateTime precision or non-comparable duration units.
issue_request: FHIR-22765 was Published/Not Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested removal of Encounter.length because recalculated duration could be stale, but the approved resolution retained Encounter.length as an actual duration and required clearer wording, a PV2-11 mapping, an estimated-duration approach outside the element, and an invariant ensuring length does not exceed the period when computable.
initial_application: Historical commit 7ac7c3010e5c7c604804b1a8831b7df36add8a03 changed source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml so Encounter.length is explicitly actual, added missing-value and low-precision clarification, and updated the v2 mapping to include PV2-11. That commit did not add the requested invariant. Later reconcile commit 55b6972198ad1e12d56bfb6615d9df709a4f152b aligned the FHIR-22765 length comment from Encounter.period to Encounter.actualPeriod after FHIR-32351.
additional_context: Encounter is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml feeds the current build. FHIR-32351 later renamed Encounter.period to Encounter.actualPeriod and separated planned dates, so the FHIR-22765 period comparison now needs to use actualPeriod. Targeted Jira searches found no later Encounter.length issue reversing the Published FHIR-22765 decision. Zulip and Confluence evidence explains the original removal concern and PA scheduling/deferral context but shows no conflicting final decision.
reconciliation: Added root invariant enc-4 to Encounter. The invariant passes when length or actualPeriod bounds are absent, passes when the period comparison cannot be computed, and otherwise requires actualPeriod.start plus length to be less than or equal to actualPeriod.end.
source_changes: source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml: added root constraint enc-4 requiring Encounter.length not to exceed the computable duration from Encounter.actualPeriod.start to Encounter.actualPeriod.end.

related_jiras.note: Renamed Encounter.period to Encounter.actualPeriod, so the FHIR-22765 invariant targets actualPeriod in the current source.

evidence_items.summary: FHIRPath supports adding time-valued quantities to DateTime values and propagates empty results for non-computable operands/comparisons.
evidence_items.learned: The invariant can express the computable-bound rule as actualPeriod.start + length <= actualPeriod.end while passing empty/non-computable cases.
